lesson_title: Healthy, Cared For and Powered Up
hook_text: Water, food and shelter are not enough. There are three more things every person needs.
clip_script: Motherwell, Gqeberha. Thabo's baby sister gets her injections at the clinic: that is health. His gogo walks him to school and checks his homework every night: that is care. At supper, the family cooks on a gas stove and switches on the light: that is energy. Some families use electricity, some use gas, paraffin, wood or the sun. Health, care and energy, needed by every person in every settlement.
visual_style: Whiteboard of a clinic cross, a heart and a lightning bolt, each linked to people in a township street.
mood: Warm and caring, with a bright finish.
pacing: One need at a time, with one family moment for each, then the safety tip about fire.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find out which kinds of energy your family uses.
